Try improving the Spanish below, then choose **Feedback**. The aim is one useful
next step, rather than a replacement answer. Open the source after the activity
to adapt its language, level and teaching focus.

**Feedback** prepares a message to paste into an AI chat. If your course has
feedback set up on the page, you can receive the reply here instead.


## Spanish practice

::: {.ai-feedback profile="language-quality" response-language="es" feedback-language="en" learner-level="Spanish course 1" context="none"}
Write two sentences about your morning. Correct and finish this draft.

::: {.feedback-criteria}
Give one useful improvement at a time without rewriting the whole response.
:::
::: {.feedback-starter}
Yo vive en Oslo. Por la mañana yo come pan.
:::
:::
